text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This morning, I had my fortune told by

Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She said taiyaki would lead me to the
one who
will show me the greatest
scenery...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But I haven't run into anybody so far...
Am I
supposed to be doing something
special?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Like... Feeding anyone who looks like
the right
person?
